Nodes, VMs and containers from Proxmox VE as entries, with their host

description: Imports nodes, VMs and LXC containers from Proxmox VE into the knowledge graph (server, VM, LXC, "runs on") and shows AI clients their state. Settings: url (e.g. https://pve.example.org:8006, valid certificate) and token (API token in the form USER@REALM!ID=SECRET; the PVEAuditor role is enough).
